description: Item impression count in the KuaiRand standard log 4/09-4/21, single-column tabs. Non-personal: the ranking is the same for every user; only the filter of already-seen items is per user.
why_this_scorer: Pre-registered rule: deploy whichever scorer wins under the protocol, even a baseline. On held-out users the personalised LightGBM did not beat it by a material margin.
label_note: is_click is KuaiRand's valid-play threshold, not a click.
metric: per-user AUC on randomly exposed impressions, test users, scored once
